title: Claim
description: One atomic factual statement. status is only raised to verified/partially_verified by a fact-check record from a different agent. confidence is computed by code (irs/rules.py), never typed by hand.

claim_type.description: fact = verifiable statement from an authoritative source; reported_claim = an entity says X about itself (e.g. marketing); estimate = a modelled figure (analyst, association); inference/interpretation = our reasoning; assumption = working premise; unknown = documented absence of evidence

unit.description: e.g. USD bn, units, wafers/month (200mm eq), %

population.description: what exactly is counted, e.g. 'WSTS semiconductor sales incl. discretes, excl. foundry double-count'

methodology.description: how the source produced the number; 'not disclosed' is allowed

evidence.description: verbatim passage or precise location (page/table) in the source that supports the claim
